title: Sofiane & Rayan — Le book (dialogue Veo, thème réseau pro)
style: Modern stylized 3D animation, warm color palette, soft cinematic lighting, expressive characters, high quality render

characters.name: Sofiane
characters.description: Sofiane, a 26-year-old North African man, short curly hair, tired but proud eyes, wearing a teal food-delivery jacket over a hoodie, backpack strap across his chest
characters.voice: young voice, a bit weary, dry humor

characters.name: Rayan
characters.description: Rayan, a 31-year-old North African man, well-trimmed beard, camel overcoat over a smart sweater, confident warm energy, expressive hands

characters.name: Nadia
characters.description: Nadia, a 45-year-old elegant businesswoman, silver-streaked dark hair in a low bun, burgundy blazer, sharp kind eyes
characters.voice: poised low voice, direct and warm

dialogue.speaker: rayan
dialogue.text: Sofiane ? Depuis quand tu livres des sushis, toi ?

dialogue.speaker: sofiane
dialogue.text: Depuis que mon bac plus cinq intéresse personne.

scenes.image_prompt: Night street in Paris, Sofiane in delivery jacket holding a thermal bag, caught off guard by Rayan leaving a restaurant, streetlights and neon reflections on wet pavement
scenes.motion_prompt: Rayan stops surprised and asks, Sofiane freezes embarrassed then answers with a bitter half-smile, adjusting his bag strap

dialogue.speaker: rayan
dialogue.text: Attends… t'as un master en marketing.

dialogue.speaker: sofiane
dialogue.text: Deux cents candidatures, Rayan. Deux cents.

scenes.image_prompt: Close on the two men face to face on the sidewalk, Rayan frowning in disbelief, Sofiane looking down holding up two fingers, cold night light
scenes.motion_prompt: Rayan frowns disbelieving, Sofiane raises two fingers slowly and looks away, breath visible in the cold air

dialogue.speaker: sofiane
dialogue.text: Ceux qui décrochent les postes, ils ont un oncle, un contact. Moi j'ai personne.

scenes.image_prompt: Sofiane sitting on his scooter looking at the ground, defeated, Rayan listening leaning against a wall, quiet empathy, night ambiance
scenes.motion_prompt: Sofiane speaks staring at the ground, shrugs slowly, Rayan listens without interrupting, nodding slightly

dialogue.speaker: rayan
dialogue.text: C'est pas ce que tu sais. C'est qui tu connais.

scenes.image_prompt: Rayan pointing gently at Sofiane with a knowing look, Sofiane rolling his eyes with sarcasm, streetlight halo behind them
scenes.motion_prompt: Rayan points at him while speaking the truth calmly, Sofiane rolls his eyes and answers deadpan

dialogue.speaker: rayan
dialogue.text: Jeudi soir. Un dîner. Huit personnes qui bossent, qui montent des boîtes. Tu viens.

scenes.image_prompt: Rayan showing his phone with a warm app interface displaying a professional dinner event card, determined smile, Sofiane leaning in skeptical, phone glow on their faces
scenes.motion_prompt: Rayan holds up his phone firmly while talking, tapping it once, Sofiane leans in squinting at the screen

dialogue.speaker: sofiane
dialogue.text: Un dîner ? Je vais dire quoi, moi ? Que je livre des makis ?

dialogue.speaker: rayan
dialogue.text: Que t'as un master et faim de bosser. Le reste, ça se voit tout seul.

scenes.image_prompt: Sofiane gesturing at his delivery jacket self-mocking, Rayan putting a firm reassuring hand on his shoulder, warm streetlight
scenes.motion_prompt: Sofiane gestures at his own jacket with self-deprecating irony, Rayan grabs his shoulder and answers looking him in the eyes

dialogue.speaker: nadia
dialogue.text: Deux cents candidatures et personne ne vous a rappelé ? Leur erreur.

scenes.image_prompt: Thursday dinner in an elegant restaurant, Nadia in burgundy blazer speaking to Sofiane across the table, Sofiane in a clean shirt listening stunned, candles and warm plates, other guests softly blurred
scenes.motion_prompt: Nadia speaks with calm authority and a slight smile, Sofiane straightens up surprised, candlelight flickers

dialogue.speaker: nadia
dialogue.text: Je monte une marque. J'ai besoin d'un marketeur qui a la niaque. Envoyez-moi votre book lundi.

scenes.image_prompt: Nadia handing her business card across the dinner table, Sofiane taking it with both hands, eyes shining, trying to stay composed, warm golden dinner light
scenes.motion_prompt: Nadia extends her card while speaking, Sofiane takes it carefully with both hands and answers instantly, a smile breaking through

dialogue.speaker: sofiane
dialogue.text: Je crois que je viens de rencontrer ma future boss.

scenes.image_prompt: Outside the restaurant at night, Sofiane holding the business card like a treasure, Rayan arriving with a proud grin, city lights bokeh
scenes.motion_prompt: Rayan asks with a knowing grin, Sofiane shows the card and answers laughing in disbelief, Rayan pulls him into a brotherly hug

scenes.vo: Ton réseau commence autour d'une vraie table. Nour Meet. Inscris-toi gratuitement.
